# Sample image guide

**Version:** v2 · 2026-01-01
**Uses:** sample production profile v1

<!-- XX-0.1 -->Rooms are shown with their structure legible, in calm light.

---

## 1. Light and framing

<!-- XX-1.1 -->**Light:** warm inside, bright outside.

<!-- XX-1.2 -->The frame keeps two props or fewer. Every image starts from a photograph of the room.

<!-- XX-1.3 -->**Points to state:**
- the floor finish to show;
- the door color to show.

---

## 2. Plan

<!-- XX-2.1 -->| Key | Register | Role | Figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| P-01 | Evening | Atmosphere | `F101` |
| P-02 | Daytime | Layout and light | `F102`–`F103` |

<!-- XX-2.2 -->**Inputs:**
- detail photographs are optional and are added only by explicit choice;
- the main photographs are the input set.

<!-- XX-2.3 -->**Kept:** the room's built features. <!-- XX-2.4 -->A move appears only where the target view includes it.
